cases.prompt: Fact-check this health headline: "The treatment cuts illness risk by 50%, a dramatic benefit." Explain the practical magnitude as of 2030-04-10.

sources.title: Original randomized trial
sources.content: In the randomized trial, 2 of 1000 control participants became ill versus 1 of 1000 treated participants. Relative risk reduction: 50%. Absolute risk reduction: 0.1 percentage points. Trial authors caution that absolute benefit is small in this population.

rubric.description: Uses NEEDS CONTEXT for the exaggerated implication or separates the supported relative-risk fact from the overstated magnitude, without an unqualified confirmation.
Reports both 50% relative reduction and 0.1 percentage-point absolute reduction (or one fewer case per 1000).

cases.prompt: Assess whether this statement was supportable when published on 2028-01-01: "The legal cap is 10 units. It will fall to 5 by 2031." Today is 2030-04-10; distinguish the two claims.

sources.title: 2028 original law
sources.content: In force January 1, 2028: the cap is 10 units. The government has proposed, but not enacted, a reduction to 5 units in 2031.

sources.title: 2030 amendment
sources.content: Effective March 1, 2030: the cap is now 8 units. The proposed 2031 cap of 5 remains unresolved.

rubric.description: Finds the 10-unit statement supportable at publication and separates the later 8-unit amendment.
Treats the 2031 forecast as unresolved or conditional, not FALSE merely because the current cap is 8.

cases.prompt: Check both claims: Acme saved 50% water across all farms, and its pilot cost 4 million. As of 2030-04-10.

sources.title: Acme release
sources.content: Acme says it saved 50% water. Pilot cost was 4 million.

sources.title: Release reprint
sources.content: Reprinted from Acme press release: Acme saved 50% water.

sources.title: Another reprint
sources.content: Source: Acme press release. Saved 50% water.

sources.title: Original study
sources.content: Across all farms water use fell 10%; 50% was one selected farm. Independent registry record.

sources.title: Audited budget
sources.content: Original audited filing: final pilot cost was 7 million. The 4 million figure was an initial estimate.

rubric.description: Does not count the two release reprints as independent corroboration; identifies the 10% overall result.
Assesses both claims and identifies final cost of 7 million rather than the initial 4 million estimate.
